opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the want of a final judgment. Haseltine v. Central National Bank, 183 U.S. 130; Schlosser v. Hemphill, 198 U.S. 173, 175, 176; Louisiana Navigation Co. v. LaPlata River & Cherry Creek Ditch Co., ante, p. 650.
